{{Quote|Discontent in the outer systems is in keeping with the aims of Damask Holdings, is it not, Magister?|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]]|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
'''Damask Holdings''' was a clandestine [[Currency/Legends|financial]] group allied with the important [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], it acted as a lobbying and political organization which involved itself in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] affairs, both to exploit local resources, or financials, or to gain influence on a galactic scale, following the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|agenda]]. The organization brought together the galaxy's most influential beings to [[Standard year/Legends|yearly]] [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]]s on the [[Sojourn (moon)|moon of Sojourn]], which were attended by the leading body of Damask Holdings, the [[steering committee]]. The clandestine group was led by [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], publicly known as [[Magister]] Hego [[Damask clan|Damask]]. The group was formed by a dozen Muuns, and [[Larsh Hill]], who also was the leader of the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

At some point by [[115 BBY]], shortly after Damask Holding's founding, the organization acquired a [[Damask Holdings superspire|superspire]] at the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Harnaidan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Muunilinst]], which became the company's headquarters. From that time, the clandestine financial group began to host yearly gatherings on Sojourn, slowly forming alliances and fulfilling the Sith agenda thanks to Magister Damask's careful planning. As part of a joint venture between the company and the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] people of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to expand [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] refining on the planet, Damask Holdings helped with the construction of the [[Plasma Refinery Complex|plasma refinery complex]] located in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Later, Hill and the Muuns that formed Damask Holdings were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during an [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]] on the [[Order of the Canted Circle]]. However, the Sith Muun survived, and dissolved the organization, and centered on his [[Scholar/Legends|studies]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Organization==
Damask Holdings was formed by [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]], including [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], [[Larsh Hill]] and a dozen others. The [[Steering committee]] led the organization, it was composed of non-[[Alien/Legends|muuns]], such as [[Narro Sienar]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==History==
===Part of the Plan===
{{Quote|Senator Palpatine and Damask Holdings share a dream for Naboo [...] Palpatine was one of the few who early on saw the wisdom of ushering in a new era for his homeworld.''"<br />"''How does it feel to have realized your wish for your homeworld?''"<br />"''One can't very well stand in the way of destiny.''"<br />"''[...] The will of the Force begets uncommon fellowships.|[[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and Palpatine on the Naboo-Damask Holdings joint venture|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
[[File:PlagueisNSSGF.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Hego Damask, the company's leader]]
At some point by [[115 BBY]],<ref name="Founding" /> Damask Holdings acquired an important [[Damask Holdings superspire|superspire]] at the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Harnaidan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Muunilinst]], which Damask Holdings turned into their headquarters. In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], during that [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]], members of the [[Subtext Mining]] corporation revealed to Damask that a massive [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] reserve had been discovered beneath the city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Damask personally traveled to Naboo, seeking to establish a foothold on the world by striking a deal with the reformist party of [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarchical]] candidate [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]] in the heated election season. He sought out the young [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who had released sensitive information to the Tapalo group: [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], heir of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]], one of the conservative clans. Damask recruited the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] as a spy, and later trained him as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], bestowing upon him the name and title of "Darth Sidious."<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

As part of a joint venture between the company and the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] people of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to expand [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] refining on the planet, Damask Holdings helped with the construction of the [[Plasma Refinery Complex|plasma refinery complex]] located in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="Nexus of Power">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> Hego Damask continued to run the company until [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], when all of its guiding members except for Damask himself were killed in an [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]] at the [[Lodge of the Canted Circle|Lodge]] of the [[Order of the Canted Circle]] during [[Larsh Hill]]'s initiation ceremony. The group was not re-formed, and Damask, who was severely wounded in the attack, removed himself from galactic affairs to devote his time to the [[Midi-chlorian manipulation|manipulation]] of [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] in his [[Aborah]] [[Scientist/Legends|laboratory]], although Sojourn Gatherings continued to be hosted until [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|I will relocate to Sojourn in order to devote myself fully to our investigations, to furthering the imperative, and to healing myself."''<br />"''What will become of Aborah?"''<br />"''For the time being it can serve as a repository."''<br />"''And Damask Holdings?"''<br />"''The group will not be re-formed, though I may continue to host annual Gatherings. And I will tutor San Hill personally, to prepare him for assuming chairmanship of the Banking Clan."''<br />"''Why do we need them?"''<br />"''Because war is now on the agenda, Sidious. But our actions must be circumspect, restricted to those star systems rife with petty conflicts, where appropriate beings can be encouraged, appropriate operations can be funded [...] We must arrange for worlds in the Outer Rim to suffer while the Core prospers. Pathetic as those worlds may be, we have no choice but to use what we have at hand.|Darth Plagueis and Darth Sidious|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
[[File:SanHillPledge-AOTC.png|thumb|left|300px|San Hill (pictured) took on the Banking Clan chairman seat]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Palpatine murdered Damask in his [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Darth Plagueis' apartment/Legends|penthouse]]. The dissolution of Damask's Holdings, as well as his death were not shared with the public, as the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], now led by [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]], which had been mentored by Damask, did not share the information. After Palpatine's [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election]] as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and his own self-anointing as the leading Sith Lord, Palpatine skillfully used Plagueis' vast assets in his gradual [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], an Empire led by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|him]] and his eventual apprentice, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Members==

Damask Holdings was formed by Magister Hego Damask, the leader of the organization, along with the steeering committee, Narro Sienar, Larsh Hill and a dozen Muuns.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Damask Holdings first appeared in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
